Forensic capture for backlog task 34996a3b ("proc spawn gate: busy-spin on coordination-pipe EOF + TERM-immunity orphans workers"). PID 4829 (`wedged-account-worker`, spawned by claude-pool's TestPrepareAccountBackingDeadlineKillsReapsAndUntracks on 2026-07-22) burned 43.2h CPU at 99% before being SIGKILLed 2026-07-25 ~14:21 PDT, after capture.

Attached: the sweep capture (first 400 sample lines + complete lsof). Key facts: PPID 1 (reparented — harness died mid-gate); fd 4 (coordination pipe) write-end gone → `read <&4` returns EOF instantly → `while ! read` busy-spins; `trap ':' TERM` armed for the whole gate → SIGTERM-immune, only SIGKILL works. Sample shows pure bash interpreter spin (strcmp under repeating eval frames, zero syscall blocking). Control case: PID 40403, identical preamble, healthy 0% CPU blocking read (writer alive).

Full artifacts also at /tmp/wedged-4829-sample.txt (115,671 bytes) and /tmp/wedged-4829-lsof.txt on the yasyf box (volatile — /tmp clears on its next reboot).
